visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands meticulously holds a white plastic rice scoop shaped like a snowman. In the background, out-of-focus shelves are packed with various consumer products, and overhead retail lighting creates a clean, commercial atmosphere. The hands are fair-skinned and move slightly to display the product's front and back. (2) The camera transitions to a wide shot of a retail display featuring dozens of colorful umbrellas. The umbrellas are organized by color—blue, teal, and yellow—on metallic racks. The setting is a spacious, modern department store aisle with a polished floor and clear price tags. No people are directly in focus, but the environment suggests a busy shopping center. The lighting is uniform and bright indoor fluorescent. (3) Close-up shots focus on specific umbrella details, such as the handles and labels indicating size suitability for children like 140cm and 150cm. A hand occasionally enters the frame to touch or point at the product features. The background remains consistent with the department store setting, showing more racks of rain gear and accessories under bright, soft indoor lighting. A hand picks up a grey slipper to show the sole's texture and anti-slip grip. Above the rack, a large informational board with graphics and Japanese text explains the product's ergonomic design. The lighting is warm and inviting. (5) In the grocery and pharmacy sections, the camera captures rows of snacks, fresh strawberries in plastic containers, and pharmaceutical products. The aisles are long and well-organized, with a high density of products. The lighting transitions from the warm tones of the shoe section to the cooler, more clinical brightness of the pharmacy aisle. Passers-by are briefly visible in the distance, establishing a lived-in shopping context. (6) The final phases show the Tax-free counter with professional signage, followed by an exterior view of a large multi-story building labeled Ito Yokado under a grey, overcast sky. The video concludes at a train station entrance where people pass through automated ticket gates. The lighting shifts to natural outdoor light and then back to artificial station lighting before the final graphic screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. [Slogan]: 日本小物 真的不要那麼貼心耶 雪人本身是一個米杯 頭跟身體各是半杯和一杯. (2) [Slogan]: 那天其實是來買童傘的 結果這些傘真的開我眼界. (3) [Slogan]: 全部都有做透明窗可看路 遮光率99%, 抗UV也99% 真的太實用. (4) [Slogan]: 還沒完 傘柄還分適合的身高 各種身長都有適合長度 (最多到150公分). (5) [Slogan]: 雨衣也不輸雨傘 全都設計成背書包也OK的大小 不用買書包雨衣也不用分開擠. (6) [Slogan]: 大人傘也設計的很棒 不只能輕鬆黏貼開關. (7) [Slogan]: 傘套開口極大, 超好收傘 底部還包起來, 不怕移動亂掉. (8) [Variety]: 收得整齊 看了就舒服. (9) [Slogan]: 不小心逛到旁邊的居家室內鞋. (10) [Slogan]: U字開口好穿脫 鞋底也有止滑功能 還能一秒變身包鞋. (11) [Slogan]: 鞋底的止滑很紮實 不怕走在平面上滑倒. (12) [Slogan]: 瞄到一個家事好幫手 「家事皂肥皂盒」. (13) [Slogan]: 這盒子設計超讚 底部直接是刷子 肥皂放進去加點水就出泡沫了 洗領子的好幫手. (14) [Slogan]: 樓上挖寶完 回到食品超市繼續. (15) [Slogan]: 大型超市真的超好挖寶 你們去日本玩一定要排一趟. (16) [Slogan]: 各種當季水果 在這裡都是超級多選擇 而且價格也便宜. (17) [Slogan]: 各種湯包 醬料也超好買 日本橋名店的湯包這裡也有喔. (18) [Slogan]: 食品包裝也更貼心了 開口缺角做在中間 更好完整倒出所有內容物 要冷藏. (19) [Variety]: 新的! [Slogan]: 棉花糖巧克力. (20) [Slogan]: 明治近期出的起司甜點 吃起來也很讚, 推推. (21) [Slogan]: 逛完吃的見到藥妝區. (22) [Slogan]: 這裡的藥品也超齊全 空間比小型藥妝店舒服許多. (23) [Slogan]: 全部買完 就能一次辦理退稅. (24) [Slogan]: 退稅免手續費 不過要注意時間喔. (25) [Logo]: Ito Yokado. [Slogan]: 我逛的是 Ito Yokado 伊藤洋華堂武藏境店. (26) [Slogan]: JR中央線直達 吉祥寺, 三鷹站附近 東京站, 新宿站過來免換車. (27) [Slogan]: 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結 按讚 分享 留言 收藏.
